selection_rule.candidate: All original and final-hold group gates, plus at least2more final-hold successes than failed matched control
selection_rule.feasibility: Before candidate budget, check control final_successes+2<=320; coverage or numerical/interface failures close the line
selection_rule.secondary_metrics: Per-joint requested-range excess, real contacts and actual support; never substitute them for motion gates
